features.name: Workspace path policy and file tree
acceptance: Open folder and file tree CRUD work in a scoped workspace
A workspace can hold multiple independently authorized canonical roots
Symlink and traversal escapes are rejected
External changes update the tree with rescan fallback

results: pnpm check passed in full on 2026-07-22: 30 frontend test files, 607 cases, 2277 frontend modules, 2112 bundle sources, 203 recorded migration-debt files and Rust 255/255.
The move+delete incomplete-outcome matrix passed 10/10 across 5 repeated runs.
An independent adversarial review of the delete incomplete-outcome matrix hardened the Harness boundary contracts to 132/132 passing hostile-mutation unit tests.
nativeScenarios: Computer Use launched the freshly built absolute Plain.app bundle and opened a temporary single-root workspace through the native macOS folder picker.
The native Explorer created an empty file, saved an exact 31-byte edit, created a nested directory, renamed within the same root and copied a file, with every result verified on disk.
External file additions and deletions converged in the Explorer on the first FSEvents poll with no manual Refresh click.
The Workbench DOM confirmation dialog was cancelled via both the Cancel button and Escape, leaving the target file and its disk bytes and SHA-256 unchanged.
After explicit user confirmation, clicking the irreversible permanent-delete action removed the target from the Explorer, the preview editor and disk, leaving the workspace directory empty.
platformGaps: The real multi-root desktop matrix (dual-root projection, cross-root disk write chain, per-root FSEvents convergence and root add/remove lifecycle) is registered as E2E-001 in docs/e2e-handover.md and handed over to Codex for native execution.
The multi-root permanent-delete desktop variant is registered as E2E-002 in docs/e2e-handover.md as a lower-priority handover to Codex.
Windows and Linux native packaging remains F120.
Zeroing the monaco-vscode-api bundle migration debt remains F110.
